description: Grants the real CI-Server web app (served remotely at http://127.0.0.1:8642 / http://localhost:8642 after the bootstrap page's window.location.replace()) enough Tauri IPC reachability to complete native 'Sign in with Companion account': open_external_url_command (launch the OIDC URL in the system browser) and take_pending_deep_link_command (drain a companion://oidc/callback deep link that arrived before the page's listener was up). Both are app-level commands (see main.rs), which Tauri's ACL does not gate per-command — reachability is the lever. `opener:allow-open-url` is required and was missing: open_external_url_command is a thin wrapper over the opener PLUGIN, and plugin permissions are checked against the CALLING webview's capabilities, so with an empty permissions list the command was reachable but the open_url inside it was denied — the sign-in button did nothing, and the frontend only console.error'd the rejection. Narrower than default.json's `opener:default` on purpose: this origin may open a URL and nothing else (no revealItemInDir, no window close/hide/show/focus), so the core:window grants stay bootstrap-only. The remaining trade-off is unchanged: this origin can still reach the app's other custom commands, since per-command scoping needs custom Rust permission definitions (src-tauri/permissions/*.toml + build.rs wiring) — a follow-up.
